The '''Tythonian Gnarls''', simply known as the '''Gnarls''', was an area of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], located just north of the valley which was the home to the heart of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
The Gnarls was the name given to an area of wild land on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Formerly the home to an ancient temple of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], many old stone bridges crossed the steady streams that crossed the region. By the time the Jedi returned to Tython following the [[Great Galactic War]], the area was overgrown with thick undergrowth and home to many wild beasts. After clearing the land and restoring the ancient stone paths, the Jedi established an [[Gnarls Outpost|outpost]] and several landing pads on a ridge overlooking a massive crevice.<ref name="TOR" />

Using the area as a training ground for [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and a place for the Jedi to practice their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], four [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] positioned at ordinal points across the area contained and displayed the records of four of the Order's founders, which included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Garon Jard]] and [[Rajivari]]. As the Jedi maintained their presence over the years, the native [[Flesh Raider]]s began to press against the Jedi's territories and conflicts became more frequent. Despite many Jedi Masters' beliefs that the added challenge for their students was healthy, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] considered moving the training grounds.<ref name="TOR" />
